text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but a past gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each position on its merits.","Selling winners while holding losing positions can reflect my discomfort with losses, so I should assess all holdings consistently rather than let average cost dictate decisions.","I traded several times in a short period, but with prices moving randomly, recent price history is not a reliable guide to what comes next."]}
